Outside of it the atmosphere is nice and has a suitable music for the type of food they offer, air conditioning at its point and there was no mix of smells on site.

reviews.title: ON TOP OF THAT CHICKEN AJI HAD FUR!!! AGGGG
reviews.text:
Bad experience – bad food

We visited Panchita (Av. Dos de Mayo, Miraflores) around 10:00 p.m. for a late dinner, and the experience was frankly deplorable.

Not only was the attention poor and selfless, but the food turned out to be a real stomach pump.
My companion ordered a chicken pepper and I ordered a stir-fried noodle. Hours later, we both started to feel really bad.

My companion ended up with a fever of 39.5 °C and severe diarrhea, and had to take antibiotics (Bactrim). In my case, I suffered an intense upset stomach for almost three days. Clearly, something was not right with the food served that night.

My recommendation is very clear:
👉 If it is late, DO NOT offer dishes that may deteriorate or are not in optimal condition.
Food safety is non-negotiable, especially in a restaurant of this level and reputation.

Conclusion: a terrible experience, totally disappointing and dangerous for health. I wouldn't come back.

reviews.title: Authentic Peruvian
reviews.text:
It’s  is a fantastic spot for authentic Peruvian cuisine. The food is genuinely delicious , Portions are generous and everything tastes fresh and homemade.
The service stands out as warm, attentive, and genuinely friendly – the staff make you feel welcome from the moment you walk in, happily explaining dishes and checking in without being intrusive. 
The lively atmosphere, with its colorful decor and open kitchen, adds to the experience.
Great value for the quality, highly recommended. Definitely one of the best criollo restaurants in Lima!

reviews.title: Fun atmosphere, good food, reasonable prices.
reviews.text: We had one dinner night in Miraflores, and wanted a place within walking distance of our hotel (INNsiDE), mid-range price and authenic Peruvian cuisine. Pachita checked all the boxes. The restaurant was very busy and service was initially slow, but once we ordered, everything was fine. Fun atmosphere, good food, reasonable prices.

reviews.title: Poor Service
reviews.text:
Extremely Disappointing Experience

I’ve never had such an unacceptable dining experience. We waited almost two and a half hours and still never received our main courses, despite asking multiple times. All we ever got was water, bread, and the appetizers.

When we finally decided to leave and simply pay for what we had actually consumed, even getting the bill became a challenge. Several servers tried to find a manager, and we waited another 15 minutes just for someone to speak with us. When the manager finally arrived, she told us, “OK, you don’t have to pay, just go.” That wasn’t even what we wanted—we just wanted our bill so we could settle up and leave.

The whole situation made it abundantly clear that this restaurant does not care at all about its customers, their time, or their experience. Truly disappointing from start to finish.

reviews.title: Disappointment in the way you sell nougat
reviews.text:
The truth is that I was very disappointed with the restaurant.At first everything fine, the food very rich, the problem came in dessert. Nobody wanted anything anymore because the dishes are very generous but the waiter insisted on trying you nougat. And so as not to make him ugly I chose to order a ration just to taste it. Then I find the surprise that he brings me a box which I did not ask for and I stressed to the waiter that I just wanted a ration which he said yes. At the time of payment I happen to be charged the whole box. And I specified that we only ate one ration and he told me that the ration was the whole box. Where I have seen that a ration is a whole box and I tell you in detail why a day earlier I went to eat so much salaverry and there I ordered a ration and they brought me a piece that is a ration. I understand it belongs to the same chain and for so much the ration is as it should be and in panchita the ration is a box
 I'm outraged as I felt ripped off in every way because on top of that they rip you off like that. I didn't put up a claim sheet at the time because it was late. And the tip thing that I know is not mandatory is the will that one has. I travel many places and I know what I am talking about.Only in some countries is it mandatory. So I think this is a top thing I don't think the waiter dares make such a scam without the knowledge of the owners, so please rate my opinion and don't let this happen again. Because for my part they've lost a client and her whole family. And as I recommend to other people, so the same thing will happen. I guess you guys know what a waiter he is because he's a snake charmer. Please keep this in mind as this modality may cause many customers to lose.

reviews.title: Very noisy, rich food and upgradable cocktails
reviews.text:
Extensive gastronomic proposal, they consider food allergies and an immersive decoration that complements the concept of the premises.

We tried the crab cause (one of the biggest I've ever seen), plus a sautéed loin and a sting called Panchito.

I had a dry gin with tonic water.

From the access, the service is friendly. Walk with time because there is waiting list and the outside area to wait, lacks enough chairs for the number of people we were waiting. The approximate wait was half an hour.

The table allocated was cute, with comfortable seating and excellent service. To my liking, the birthday celebration format is exaggeratedly loud. You could sing and bring a cupcake with candle, but at our evening, at least they sang 20 times!!! The voice of the attendees is lost and the noise is loud, intense and breaks any kind of conversation. So, if you’re taking customers, you’d better look for another quieter place. It's the lowest point of the whole experience.

The dishes arrived on time, with the right temperature and cute presentation, as did the drinks. I've had a lot of gin and this one didn't surprise me, there's no great variety in this cocktail and the almost winning option everywhere, didn't completely please me. He wasn’t untouchable either, but he lacked affection.

The prices are high, but for my taste, proportional to the size of the dishes. Waiters don’t force tipping and even with that scoop, they have a very high Standard of Service.

I would return, but afraid to meet again with so many birthday celebrations, that they break into the evening with little tint.

Perfect spot for three tired travellers.

reviews.title: Panchita Restaurant Review
reviews.text:
1.0 General Impression
1.1 Rating & Justification
Overall Rating: 2.5 out of 5 stars

Reasoning: The rating reflects strong positives in aesthetics and service quality, but significant negatives in food taste and quality.

2.0 Positive Highlights
2.1 Ambience & Presentation
Exterior & Interior Design: Immaculate; both outside and inside design felt upscale and thoughtfully curated.

Table Setup: Elegant presentation of napkins, utensils, and table layout enhanced the dining experience visually.

2.2 Service
Server Attention: Exceptional service; the waiter was attentive, respectful, and contributed positively to the experience.

2.3 Beverages
Chicha Morada & Jugo de Maracuyá: Enjoyable and well-prepared; both drinks were praised and even reordered.

3.0 Negative Highlights
3.1 Food Quality & Flavor
Causa: Presentation was okay; taste unremarkable.

Anticuchos: Described as bland and flavorless, with hard potatoes and tasteless corn. Even the sauce couldn't redeem it.

Ají de Gallina: Disappointing, described as having no flavor despite being a traditionally rich dish.

Arroz con Pollo: Similarly lacked flavor; overall taste profile did not meet expectations.

Wings: Acceptable, but generic – not part of traditional Peruvian fare and nothing special.

3.2 Comparative Disappointment
Visited both cheaper and more expensive restaurants nearby, all of which outperformed Panchita in flavor and food quality.

The high online ratings (e.g., 4.5 on TripAdvisor, “Travelers’ Choice 2024”) did not align with the actual experience.

4.0 Cultural Context & Final Thoughts
4.1 Expectations vs. Reality
Family of native Peruvians used to eating Peruvian food daily at home—felt this restaurant did not meet traditional flavor standards.

Despite visual appeal and hype, the food did not deliver in authenticity or taste.

Left disappointed to the point of giving away leftovers and not photographing subsequent meals.

4.2 Future Consideration
I might be willing to return under different circumstances.

Family members unlikely to revisit due to strong dissatisfaction.

5.0 Conclusion
Recommendation: Not recommended for those seeking authentic Peruvian flavors or value for money.

Summary Sentence: Panchita impresses in aesthetics and service, but disappoints profoundly in culinary execution—especially for locals accustomed to genuine Peruvian cuisine.
reviews.review_tip: I think going at night will be beneficial to really see the restaurant when the lights are dim and you get to see the colors pop out.

reviews.text: Spacious restaurant with nice decoration. Good service. Creole cuisine with a lot of variety. I would highlight the octopus strip and the rice with duck and coriander, very good. Exceptional desserts I recommend sharing portions as they are abundant.

reviews.text: I really liked the food , the service and the atmosphere, anyway I would come back, your Creole food is very good in portion and quality.

reviews.title: Not to forget
reviews.text: Joyful environment with colorful decoration.  The lunch was delicious, but the highlight was the dessert, I suck to the limeña, this will stay in the tasteful memory.  Fortunately, I arrived early, about half a day, soon after the restaurant was crowded and a queue was formed.

reviews.title: The best we had in Peru!
reviews.text:
We ate in a few really good places in Peru but Panchita was the best of them all. The restaurant is very tastefully decorated and the food was on another level! Our food was cooked perfectly and even the bread beforehand….that could be a meal itself it’s that good. 
This place is a must while in Lima 10/10!

reviews.title: Good request
reviews.text:
Well filled, but worth the wait. 
Dishes very well served, sharing may be worth it. Relaxed and family environment

reviews.title: Nice atmosphere
reviews.text: My friend wanted to try this restaurant and so we ended up going there. We had to wait for 30 mins to get a table on a weekend for lunch. Sadly for me as a Vegetarian I had very limited options. But I loved the vibes and ambiance of the place. I also get to witness how Peruvians celebrate their birthday. The staff was playing the music and people were dancing. I tried a traditional Arequipan dessert Queso Helado here which tasted like a Coconut IceCream. The taste was fine. I didn’t have anything else here.

reviews.title: incredible rocoto relleno
reviews.text: Although I'd heard about how great Peruvian food was, most of my experience had been so-so (with a few exceptions) until coming here. W o w. Food, drinks, everything was impeccable. The rocoto relleno appetizer is outstanding. I enjoyed the anticuchos and arroz don Jose as well. No misses in the meal at all.

reviews.title: Experience of 10
reviews.text: Food of ten, attention on the part of Caesar L exquisite and recommendation of dishes unbeatable. Of course, you have to go hungry because the portions are giant!!

reviews.title: Avoid
reviews.text: Terrible service! Average food.  It took a half hour for a waiter, after waiting 40 minutes for a table. Average food with bad service followed.

reviews.title: Wonderful Peruvian food in a pleasant atmosphere.
reviews.text: The food was exquisite and the service and atmosphere excellent. We had sea bass and pork chicharron, both attractively presented and tasty   Our waiter, Pepe, was attentive but not intrusive and offered suggestions about the food. The Cabernet Franc that was served was full bodied and wonderfully balanced. Our dessert, Suspiro ala Limena, a splendid concoction of caramel and meringue was a perfect ending to a great eating experience.

reviews.title: I don't recommend it.
reviews.text: I found it a fairly regular restaurant in its quality of food , perhaps there is a lot of marketing behind but when it comes to eating one simply does not notice that for the price they charge the quality stands out from other restaurants in the area, I would even say that the quality is below the average of the area . I already inform that for each dish 2 or 3 people can eat , that is, the ration is quite abundant but the quality is regular only. It is not a restaurant where you can notice the hand of a chef and I would not recommend it for those who value the quality of food as an essential part of their trip.

reviews.title: Environment and food
reviews.text:
Amazing everything!! Excellent food, atmosphere and service.
100% recommended. Of the best in Peru. 100/100. Recommended

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Excellent Peruvian food, the place is very nice and the service very good, The sautéed loin is the best I have ever eaten, and the portions are very abundant. The price is according to the quality received.

reviews.title: Good but NOISY
reviews.text:
The good :
The drinks and service were very good .   Food was very tasty, and prices not terrible.
The bad:
NOISE level.  VERY Loud. Need to work on the acoustics. It’s a beautiful restaurant, but  they didn’t work on better acoustics.  Can’t hear across the.table.
There was an extra service fee on beill - we have been in Lima for days, that we never saw at another restaurant.  Asked the server who could not explain very well. Asked for someone to explain in English please. He said he’d send someone.  Waited 10 minutes after we paid and finished. No one came. Don’t know what that charge was.
reviews.review_tip: Don't go if you can’t handle a LOUD LOUD place

reviews.title: Nothing special
reviews.text: Taste is known to be very individual and for some, the portion size alone is a measure of quality. If you judge like that, you'll be in good hands here. If, on the other hand, you place more emphasis on differentiated and subtler taste nuances, you should go further! Just as an example: Ají de gallina is synonymous here with a sauce orgy that poses maximum challenges to the stomach but leaves the taste buds largely untroubled. The braised beef rib shines through perfectly summed up taste boredom, only the ceviche can inspire without restriction, although the seafood portion is not marinated in it, but cooked. The fact that the starter and main course are applied with only a few minutes of delay can no more improve the overall impression than the fact that the noise level can certainly compete with that of a bus station.

reviews.title: Delicious Food!
reviews.text: Another amazing restaurant by Gastón Acurio, the best chef in Peru! I love this place, everything on the menu is delicious. It’s one of the best spot for Peruvian food! The soups are flavorful, the anticuchos are delicious, and the lomo saltado is a must-try. The drinks are great, the service is very attentive and friendly, and the decor has a beautiful Peruvian touch. This restaurant is a must-visit when in Lima!

reviews.title: A popular place in Lima
reviews.text: This is a very well-known restaurant and we were lucky to get a table for 2 without having reservations. The ambiance is very nice and service is great. Lots of interesting items on the menu and portions are very big. The seafood rice and clams with cheese were supreme. There was absutlely no place for dessert. Service was very good and prices are on the higher side.

reviews.title: Nice place

reviews.title: The quality of the food is not as it used to be
reviews.text: This is not the first time I have lunch at Panchita when in Lima. I like their food, but over the past few years, I have noticed that the quality of the food has been diminishing. To begin, the quality of the potatoes they use is the worst. If someone chooses to go to a good Peruvian restaurant in Lima, it is to taste the best potatoes we have in town, not the watery, sticky ones. Their cocktails are also watery. It is sad to see that such a great restaurant is lowering its standards.

reviews.title: Very good place
reviews.text: Very nice inside, quiet fancy, even though a little too loud. Great service, great food, very generous quantity. The price for the quantity is quiet fair. Had a very good time.

reviews.title: Special restaurant in Lima
reviews.text: Comida top. Price above market average but worth it. The body pancetta and very good and the cevite as well. A delicious food beautiful restaurant and very nice service

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text:
Super nice environment, excellent service from Felix, tasty dishes and good location in Miraflores.
The parmesan conchitas are delicious.

reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text:
OMG .  SO good!  After a week in Lima and a whole lotta cevihe, which I love, I wanted meat.  They did not disappoint.  I had a wonderful Argentinian steak and delicious pisco sour.  I am gluten free due to Celiac, which they fully understood (I had a translation card with me).  My husband ordered cuy, which I wasn't able to try do to it not being gluten free, but he enjoyed it.  

Be sure to make a reservation though!    We didn't, and ended up waiting about 40 minutes on a Wednesday night.
reviews.review_tip: Make a reservation!

reviews.title: Great Peruvian restaurant
reviews.text: Great food and ambiance! The waiting was like 10 minutes at lunch time week day. Our waiter was amazing and the food was delicious. I’m Peruvian and totally recommend this place if you want to try good Peruvian food.

reviews.title: Birthday celebration in Panchita.
reviews.text: We went to celebrate my chicken's birthday. The staff was super good. We asked for dish recommendations, as we didn’t want the typical fish (because we had already had lunch that). The food is blunt so I recommend either asking for funds or first share something and see if you have room for more food. We ordered a lime cause, which was huge and some croquettes filled with chickpea, that to share, all super rich! And in the background Lomo Saltado and Tacu Tacu with loin. I am a fan of Tacu Tacu and I loved it. Since it was birthday at the reservation I explained the reason and the staff sang happy birthday and brought us a dessert to share by the house. It was entertaining! I recommend going and don't forget to book as there are always quite a lot of people in the place.

reviews.title: I felt the creamy texture and taste balanced between the sweet and the bitter of tiramisu
reviews.text: Dessert was delicious, I felt the creamy texture and taste balanced between the sweet and the bitter of tiramisu. Their combination of coffee, mascarpone cheese and cocoa powder is simply irresistible.

reviews.text: We went for a Sunday lunch and were not disappointed. We were a party of 9 and everyone left happy. There is a large menu that should suit everyone. The Lamo and Pollo Saltado were excellent. The portions are enormous, so splitting could be better for some people. The only disappoinement were the desserts.

reviews.title: Amazing food
reviews.text: Best restaurant I’ve visited in Lima. It was extremely busy, but was able to get a spot on the bar as a solo traveler. The wait staff were very attentive and helped me navigate the menu. Food was spectacular.

reviews.title: Wouldn't come back
reviews.text: The restaurant has a very nice decor, the food is good, but not the best in the world, there are other places much more interesting, and the service ends up leaving the experience boring. The service is slow, we almost had to beg for us to be served and even so with a half rough air, would not return!

reviews.title: Large dishes

We ordered a creole ossobuco that gave to 2 people for 78 souls. It came very fast and was very tasty.
We only find the environment noisy because of the families.

reviews.title: Very good, very good.
reviews.text: We highly recommended this restaurant located in the upper part of Miraflores. On the weekend, from what we were told at the door, they do not take reservations, but it is on a first-come, first-served basis. They kept us waiting half an hour even though there were several empty tables, I think it is part of the experience, and they sat us in a separate piece, which did not have the same imprint of the main hall. On the contrary, it was rather unwelcoming and ugly. The waiter, very assemblage but insistent, I try that we ask a lot and most expensive. Will you be paid extra for the value of the account?  Be careful! The dishes are huge. Rich and not expensive considering the amount. Ideal to go in large groups and share. If you're looking for something finer, this isn't the place.

reviews.title: Worth a visit when in Lima
reviews.text: The restaurant provided an excellent environment. The service was excellent, and the food was incredible. Considering the excellent reviews, this restaurant lived up to the expectations.

reviews.text: It’s a big classic Peruvian restaurant.  Worth trying if new to Peru. Big portions and has many of the classic Peruvian dishes. Recommend the cow heart skewers and duck rice.

reviews.title: Excellent restaurant and very well served
reviews.text:
This place was a find. We were lucky, because there was a big queue and it ended up freeing up a seat. 
Nice, the service was very good and the food was flawless. 
Be careful what you ask for, the portions are huge.
We ordered a limeña cause of entry, reminds a bit of the salty pie from Brazil made with cream potatoes. But it was almost such a big meal. 
They offer a puppy at first, but don't be mistaken, it will be charged.

Os pães oferecidos são cobrados.

Whenever you visit Lima, be sure to eat at this place.

5 stars meal, great service, a bit slow but totally understandable why. Food was just outstanding, the octopus was to die for. 
Have to have the Pachamanca.

reviews.title: Cuisine with national flavor
reviews.text: Excellent cuisine, friendly staff and very, very tasty! The main emphasis is on meat dishes, the restaurant is very popular, so make a reservation in advance.

reviews.title: Excellent dinner in Miraflores
reviews.text: We got the mixed starters to share. All very good. Fast and friendly service. The venue is very scenic. Prices slightly above average.

reviews.title: You Won't Leave Hungry
reviews.text: Really nice meal at the end of our trip. We had a 5:00 reservation. The place was really filling up when we left just before 7:00.  The portions are huge. My husband and I split the arroz donmiguero (half a chicken, enough rice for 4 people). Really good. Also tried a chicha morada. This Peruvian drink reminds me of Christmas because of the cinnamon and cloves in it. Because we were leaving for the airport after dinner the staff let us pay part of our bill in cash and the balance with a card which was appreciated (we tipped in cash). A nice dinner.

reviews.title: Great option in Lima
reviews.text: Great option in Lima! The waiting line is a bit confusing and there is no option to follow online, but the food is worth the wait. The drinks are delicious and the food, in addition to being tasty, is very well served, we regret not sharing, there was plenty of food left over. The atmosphere is very charming and the service is very friendly!

reviews.title: Go for it, it’s worth the detour
reviews.text:
Great experience in this restaurant, quality menus and simply gigantic portions!! You can have 1 dish for 2 without problem
Magnificent setting
Correct price

reviews.title: Fabulous food and unbeatable service!
reviews.text:
Some friends went to eat typical Peruvian food, on the recommendation of others. The truth is that it does not disappoint.

The kitchen is excellent and the service unbeatable.

The portions are super abundant, very colorful and tasty. We had corn pie (delicious), ceviche, sautéed loin with vegetables, chicken cracklings, causa and roasted bacon. Everything was spectacular, as well as tasty and on point. For dessert we had some delicious donuts with fig honey. All accompanied by pisco sour and water.

It is worth visiting the place and trying its delicious dishes.

reviews.title: Excellent dinner in Miraflores
reviews.text: Magnificent experience, we had crispy bacon, octopus and bolyucas for dinner, we drank Cuzco beer and orange juice and we had the best attention from our waiter Félix, very friendly and attentive and very knowledgeable about the dishes we tasted, his recommendations were excellent, highly recommended
reviews.review_tip: Muy recomendable y volveremos

reviews.title: A success !
reviews.text:
The restaurant is decorated super beautifully and is cozy, the staff is very attentive and the food is super good and abundant.
We tried the octopus, grilled chicken and a cheese and coconut ice cream dessert… a spectacle of flavors!!

reviews.title: Best chocro empanada ever
reviews.text:
In the 10 days I was in Peru it was my best meal.

They serve very regional Creole cuisine, everything is very tasty,

Waiter Anderson's service is impeccable

reviews.title: Traditional peruvian food
reviews.text: A very large selection of traditional peruvian dishes. It was very good. We had the Lomo Saltado and the Cebiche. Very tasty. We got a table without a reservation although a lot of people seem to have reservations. The service was good as well. A bit slow but we were not in a hurry. The waiters were very good at answering our questions and a couple spoke English. The prices were a bit high but the quality was good. It was located in Miraflores near our hotel. I highly recommend.

reviews.title: Authentic experience
reviews.text: We went to eat there based on a recommendation from the Ikonik hotel. Place with a beautiful decoration, they helped us choose the dishes since we didn't know what they were about and everything was very good. Excellent service!

reviews.title: top
reviews.text: Excellent local dishes of very high quality, generous, top-notch service with a dedicated server who introduces himself and takes care of the table from start to finish. Real customer service! Room has a very noisy atmosphere.

reviews.title: delicious lunch

The food was exquisite, tasty, adequate portion, I found the pisco sour a little stronger and drier.
Very good attention from the waiters, totally recommended.

reviews.title: Delicious Peruvian food
reviews.text: The food simply delicious. The very nice atmosphere. And the service is definitely top notch. We recommend it.

reviews.title: Nothing to highlight, very average food
reviews.text:
Honestly, it was not one of the best restaurants I tried during my trip to Peru.
The food is not remarkable, rather very average, we ordered a large mixed dish and there was nothing that we loved, chicha morada drink.
The place is nice but... little else

reviews.title: Great authentic food
reviews.text: Food is amazing.  Authentic Peruvian place. Great atmosphere and friendly staff.  Five stars for sure.  Different locations, reservation suggested or required for most of them.

reviews.title: Unforgetable experience
reviews.text: Going to Panchita is evoking the flavors of my childhood, they offer a wide variety of Peruvian Creole dishes, from chicharrones, ají de gallina and the delicious picarones, highly recommended, it's worth the wait

reviews.title: Ask how big are the portions!
reviews.text: Delicious, but the waiter should have told us that what we ordered was way too much for two people. We both ordered the Osobuco.

reviews.title: Great place to celebrate and eat.
reviews.text: Great restaurant.  Food was delicious and the staff were amazing.   I was there for my 50 th birthday and they made it special.  A special thanks to Jorge T who was our server.

reviews.title: Good food, nothing spectacular (except for the size)
reviews.text:
This place is a good place if you want to enjoy those types of dishes that are too big for a normal person ....

It was a good place to go, with good food, but it’s normal food in huge plates ... you must share not eat by yourself... something we could have been warned by the staff but they didn’t ....

I don’t think we are repeating this place.

reviews.title: Terrible experience
reviews.text:
Horrible experience!
1. Waiter took forever to take our order.
2. We did ask for ice and hot sauce that never came
3. I asked to pack a piece of chicken to take home, but I was given nothing (the last person to get our money didn’t know about it)
I wouldn’t recommend this place. They just want our money and their service is poor

reviews.title: Begging for cash
reviews.text: The food was excellent, the service was less than average. Our server Félix was very unprofessional. After I offered the normal 10% tip in Lima, he suggested that a 15% would be a better tip and he also requested the tip to be in cash.

reviews.title: Best food experience in Lima
reviews.text: We chose Panchita for our last dinner in Lima. We were apprehensive of the long waiting of 45-60 minutes but were lucky to get a table for 4 instantly. This is huge restaurant with large capacity but despite the large noodles guests they work with precision. As soon as we sat, Caesar came to us and introduced himself as our dedicated waiter. It was heartening to see that he had time and patience to explain the Peruvian dishes and drinks  in English. Then there was supervisor Carlos who was checking on each table. The drinks were amazing ( inka punch, Sangria ). The food was also outstanding ( please see pics ) The bill was reasonable   around 600 sols. This food experience will stay in our memories for long.

reviews.title: Authentic Peruvian Experience
reviews.text: Authentic Peruvian Cuisine. Waiter assisted us as we have limited Spanish. Portion sizes were huge and delicious. Red sangria is a must.

reviews.title: Excellent meal
reviews.text: Excellent dishes and drinks. The food was very good in terms of quality, presentation and quantity. Garzon/Bartender Anthony was always very attentive to us and made the visit very enjoyable, thank you very much.'
